text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While the Mejiro legacy is still fresh<n>in people's
memories, for Mejiro<n>Dober, the challenge of the
Twinkle<n>Series is about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her goal is to become a strong racer<n>who can
always run confidently, and<n>we decide the first step
toward that<n>goal is to leave a good impression
during her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Mejiro Bright, a fellow<n>member of the
Mejiro family and<n>Mejiro Dober's peer, comes by.
Their partner running is so intense<n>that even the
surrounding observers<n>get riled up!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Watching them, I'm confident that<n>Mejiro Bright
will be a wonderful rival<n>for Mejiro Dober. And
thus, our three<n>years together begin!
